steps.description: This is a machine learning investigation concerning bootstrap resampling, neural network generalization, and solution space rigidity (Hessian analysis), not a materials science or physics simulation. The provided context and hypothesis are empty. I will use the `skill` mode to initiate a structured investigation using the `ml_analysis` skill. This involves setting up a controlled experiment to generate bootstrap samples, training a neural network (MLP/CNN), evaluating generalization error, computing Hessian-based rigidity metrics, and performing statistical correlation analysis (ANOVA) to test the hypothesis that solution space rigidity predicts generalization stability.
